Cadence

Reads each site's measured change rate (changes per day, time-normalised so a monthly site isn't scored as "very active") and puts it on the cadence that rate implies. Sites without enough history say so — a category guess is never presented as a measurement.
SiteWasNowPhase λ /dayRunsBasis

Put finished sites on a cadence

Every site the crawler finished — pages stored and nothing left unresolved — goes onto the schedule at the cadence you pick. Sites still carrying unresolved URLs are left alone, and anything already scheduled is skipped, so this is safe to press after every batch.

Crawled sites

? means no service reported that number — hover it to see which one is missing. It is not a zero. The crawler keeps per-URL outcomes only for runs still in memory, and dedupe/gate counters only for scheduled runs, so a host crawled by a direct batch shows its stored pages with no verification record.

Interrupted crawls

A crawl lands here when it was cut short — an operator stop, the engine wall-clock, or a container restart — and still has URLs it discovered but never processed. Resuming reloads exactly those and puts the already-crawled ones straight into seen, so they are not fetched twice. A crawl that spent its max_pages budget or ran its site dry is finished, not interrupted, and does not appear.
